headline: Discussion with Waste Management on a five-year curbside trash, recycling, and dumpster contract, at $2,689,790 to $3,269,461 a year.
summary: Item C-27-45 covers curbside trash and recycling and dumpster pickup at certain locations by Waste Management of Londonderry, Inc. The agenda lists annual and monthly rates for each of five years, followed by questions and answers and public input.
items: C-27-45: Waste Management of Londonderry, Inc. contract for curbside trash and recycling, plus dumpster pickup at certain locations
Discussion with Waste Management representatives: questions and answers
location: Great Hall, Searles Building, 41 Pleasant Street, Methuen, MA 01844
